customers_say: Customers find the digital lock easy to install and use, with good service and security features, and one customer notes it works well on wooden doors. Moreover, they appreciate its multiple access options and consider it a good home security solution. However, the reliability and value for money receive mixed feedback, with some saying it functions well while others report issues, and some find it good value while others consider it costly.
